message.content:
The title of “best player” in soccer is highly debated and often depends on criteria such as current form, influence on games, trophies won, or individual skill. As of mid‑2026, many consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top contenders:

| Player | Current Club | Recent Highlights |
|--------|--------------|-------------------|
| Lionel Messi | Inter Miami (MLS) | 2025 MLS MVP, 2026 Copa América winner with Argentina, still scoring at a high rate and leading his team to the MLS Cup final. |
| Kylian Mbappé | Paris Saint‑Germain (PSG) | 2025 Ligue 1 top scorer, 2026 FIFA World Cup finalist with France, consistently delivering decisive goals and assists in Champions League matches. |

Other strong candidates include **Erling Haaland** (Manchester City), **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City), and **Neymar Jr.** (Al‑Hilal). Ultimately, the “best” player can vary depending on whether you prioritize club success, international achievements, or individual brilliance.
